newsitem.title: USA: Hawaii Gov. signs $1 bln capital projects budget.
newsitem.headline: Hawaii Gov. signs $1 bln capital projects budget.

text.p: Hawaii Gov. Ben Cayetano signed in law a $1 billion, two-year capital improvement projects budget designed to create jobs and boost the state's economy, his office said Wednesday.
The $1 billion building budget -- two-and-a-half times the size of the usual budget for state construction -- will pay for statewide infrastructure improvements.
The governor's office said the state's investment would boost Hawaii's lagging construction sector.
Last week the governor also approved the state's $6.2 billion spending plan for the next two years.
In addition, the governor signed into law a bill to consolidate the functions of the Hawaii Housing Authority, Hawaii Finance and Development Corp and the Rental Housing Trust Fund Commission.
